reference: Fraley, R. C., Waller, N. G., & Brennan, K. A. (2000). An item response theory analysis of self-report measures of adult attachment. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 78(2), 350-365.
license: Items published by the authors for use in the public domain in non-commercial research; commercial use requires the authors' permission (labs.psychology.illinois.edu/~rcfraley/measures).

provenance.en: Verbatim original wording, taken from psytools 0.6.3 (npm, src/inventories/ecr-r.ts), which reproduces the original instrument. Reverse keys match Fraley's item page (anxiety: 9, 11; avoidance: 20, 22, 26-31, 33-36).
provenance.zh: Working Chinese translation made for this skill from the English original. It is NOT a validated Chinese adaptation.

instructions.en: The statements below concern how you feel in emotionally intimate relationships. We are interested in how you generally experience relationships, not just in what is happening in a current relationship. Respond to each statement by indicating how much you agree or disagree with it.
instructions.zh: 下面的陈述涉及你在情感亲密关系中的感受。我们关心的是你在亲密关系中一贯的体验，而不仅仅是当前这段关系里正在发生的事。请对每一条陈述，表明你同意或不同意的程度。

items.en: I'm afraid that I will lose my partner's love.
items.zh: 我害怕会失去伴侣的爱。

items.en: I often worry that my partner will not want to stay with me.
items.zh: 我常常担心伴侣不想和我在一起。

items.en: I often worry that my partner doesn't really love me.
items.zh: 我常常担心伴侣并不是真的爱我。

items.en: I worry that romantic partners won't care about me as much as I care about them.
items.zh: 我担心恋人对我的在乎，不如我对他/她的在乎那么多。

items.en: I often wish that my partner's feelings for me were as strong as my feelings for him or her.
items.zh: 我常常希望伴侣对我的感情，能像我对他/她的感情一样强烈。

items.en: I worry a lot about my relationships.
items.zh: 我经常为自己的感情关系担忧。

items.en: When my partner is out of sight, I worry that he or she might become interested in someone else.
items.zh: 伴侣不在我身边时，我会担心他/她可能对别人产生兴趣。

items.en: When I show my feelings for romantic partners, I'm afraid they will not feel the same about me.
items.zh: 当我向恋人表达感情时，我害怕对方对我没有同样的感觉。

items.en: I rarely worry about my partner leaving me.
items.zh: 我很少担心伴侣会离开我。

items.en: My romantic partner makes me doubt myself.
items.zh: 我的恋人让我怀疑自己。

items.en: I do not often worry about being abandoned.
items.zh: 我不太常担心被抛弃。

items.en: I find that my partner(s) don't want to get as close as I would like.
items.zh: 我发现伴侣不愿意像我希望的那样和我亲近。

items.en: Sometimes romantic partners change their feelings about me for no apparent reason.
items.zh: 有时恋人会无缘无故地改变对我的感情。

items.en: My desire to be very close sometimes scares people away.
items.zh: 我想要非常亲近的渴望，有时会把人吓跑。

items.en: I'm afraid that once a romantic partner gets to know me, he or she won't like who I really am.
items.zh: 我害怕恋人一旦真正了解我，就不会喜欢真实的我。

items.en: It makes me mad that I don't get the affection and support I need from my partner.
items.zh: 得不到伴侣给我需要的关爱和支持，这让我很恼火。

items.en: I worry that I won't measure up to other people.
items.zh: 我担心自己比不上别人。

items.en: My partner only seems to notice me when I'm angry.
items.zh: 我的伴侣似乎只在我生气的时候才注意到我。

items.en: I prefer not to show a partner how I feel deep down.
items.zh: 我不愿让伴侣看到我内心深处的感受。

items.en: I feel comfortable sharing my private thoughts and feelings with my partner.
items.zh: 和伴侣分享我私密的想法和感受，我觉得很自在。

items.en: I find it difficult to allow myself to depend on romantic partners.
items.zh: 我很难允许自己依赖恋人。

items.en: I am very comfortable being close to romantic partners.
items.zh: 和恋人亲近让我感到非常自在。

items.en: I don't feel comfortable opening up to romantic partners.
items.zh: 向恋人敞开心扉让我感到不自在。

items.en: I prefer not to be too close to romantic partners.
items.zh: 我不愿和恋人太过亲近。

items.en: I get uncomfortable when a romantic partner wants to be very close.
items.zh: 当恋人想和我非常亲近时，我会感到不自在。

items.en: I find it relatively easy to get close to my partner.
items.zh: 我觉得和伴侣亲近相对容易。

items.en: It's not difficult for me to get close to my partner.
items.zh: 和伴侣亲近对我来说并不难。

items.en: I usually discuss my problems and concerns with my partner.
items.zh: 我通常会和伴侣讨论我的问题和顾虑。

items.en: It helps to turn to my romantic partner in times of need.
items.zh: 需要帮助时，向恋人求助是有用的。

items.en: I tell my partner just about everything.
items.zh: 我几乎什么都告诉伴侣。

items.en: I talk things over with my partner.
items.zh: 遇到事情我会和伴侣好好商量。

items.en: I am nervous when partners get too close to me.
items.zh: 伴侣和我太亲近时，我会紧张。

items.en: I feel comfortable depending on romantic partners.
items.zh: 依赖恋人让我感到自在。

items.en: I find it easy to depend on romantic partners.
items.zh: 我觉得依赖恋人很容易。

items.en: It's easy for me to be affectionate with my partner.
items.zh: 对伴侣表达亲昵，对我来说很容易。

items.en: My partner really understands me and my needs.
items.zh: 我的伴侣真正理解我和我的需要。
